penalize_from.description: `notice`, `warning`, `final` or `never`: the least serious lateness penalized.

share.description: Per mille of the offered bound taken, 1 … 1 000.

Commute.description: A commute policy: how early a person sets out for a punctual part of the day (§0.4). Every field may be omitted and keeps its default; the defaults were fixed before any run (`ARC-23`).

cap_minutes.description: Minutes, 15 … 480: the most a lead may be, and the lead when the place is not in `ways`.

mode.description: `plan` (set out from the estimate) or `at-boundary` (set out when the part begins).

slack.description: Per mille added to the estimate, 0 … 2 000: detours and replans.

assign.description: Which policy a seat, or every seat of a class, uses; one entry per seat and one per class.

default.description: The policy of every seat no memory assignment names. Absent, the cognition process's own default.

MemoryAssignment.description: One memory assignment: exactly one of seat and class, and the policy.

fallback.description: The policy used when this one cannot run.

parameters.description: The policy's parameters, passed through as written: a mapping with text keys and no YAML tags.

seat.description: A person of the world listed under seats: in world.yaml.

store_bound_mib.description: The per-person memory store's bound, in MiB, which a world may raise above the cognition host's floor of 20 MiB. Absent, the floor. Passed through as written; the cognition host judges it.

MemoryPolicy.description: A memory policy, with its fallback and parameters.

fallback.description: The policy used when this one cannot run.

parameters.description: The policy's parameters, passed through as written: a mapping with text keys and no YAML tags.

store_bound_mib.description: The per-person memory store's bound, in MiB, which a world may raise above the cognition host's floor of 20 MiB. Absent, the floor. Passed through as written; the cognition host judges it.

Mode.description: Whether the person plans the way at all.

oneOf.description: Set out early enough to arrive by the part's `from`, from the estimate.
Set out when the part begins, as before punctual parts existed: arrive one walk late.

NeedsPolicy.description: `rule`'s needs policy (SD-Nc-1, amended by Q-S35-OP1). Every field may be omitted and keeps its default; the defaults are step-35 §6.2's as amended on 2026-10-19 (`ARC-286`, amendment).

bedtime_spread_minutes.description: Minutes, 0 … 240: each person's bedtime is `night.from` plus a seeded offset up to this.

eat_from.description: Hunger at which a held food is eaten, 1 … 1 000.

exhausted_from.description: Tiredness at which bed is chosen at any hour, 1 … 1 000 and at least `tired_from`. The default, 1 000, is the scale's top: outside the night only the fully exhausted go to bed (Q-S35-OP1 (a)).

fetch_food.description: Whether a hungry person who holds nothing nourishing goes for food (Q-S35-OP1 (b)).

fetch_from.description: Hunger at which a person holding nothing nourishing goes for food, 1 … 1 000.

night.description: The hours a tired person goes to bed in.

shop_tags.description: The tags of a place that sells, as the world tags its places; at most 8. A doorway to a place carrying any of them is where food is fetched from.

sleep_until.description: `night-end` (sleep from bedtime to the next end of the night, even when exhaustion sent me to bed before it began) or `rested`.

tired_from.description: Tiredness at which bed is chosen inside the night, 1 … 1 000.

wake_for_commute.description: Whether to sleep no longer than the departure for a punctual next part allows.

Night.description: The hours a person goes to bed in when tired: from `from` until `until`, which may wrap midnight.

until.description: When it ends, `"HH:MM"`; never equal to `from`.

PenalizeFrom.description: The least serious lateness a boss penalizes.

Precedence.description: Where a due departure stands among a model's hard rungs.

oneOf.description: Before answering an invitation or a line: a due departure is asked first.
After answering an invitation or a line.

Roles.description: The tags that make a place a role (§5.4): the first role whose tags intersect a place's tags names it. Each role lists at most eight tags (SD-DLb-7).

outdoor.description: Places a person is outdoors in.

SleepUntil.description: How long a person who goes to bed inside the night sleeps for (Q-S35-OP1 (a)).

oneOf.description: Until the night ends (`night.until`), or the commute's leave-by, whichever comes first.
Until rested (tiredness ÷ the disclosed rest per hour), as before the ruling.

description: Which decision model drives each seat of the world, and which memory policy each seat's controller uses. Every key is optional; with no file every seat is driven by the rule model.

assign.description: Which model drives a seat, or every seat of a class. A seat's entry wins over its class's, and a class's over the default; one entry per seat and one per class.

default.description: The model that drives every seat no assignment names. Absent, the rule model.

memory.description: Which memory policy each seat's controller uses. Absent, the cognition process's own default for every seat.

models.description: The models this file configures, each once, by id: an in-process model's parameters, an out-of-process model's fallback. A model used but not listed runs with its defaults.

lm.description: The lm model, which runs out of process; it must name a fallback.

fallback.description: The model that drives the seat while this one is absent or out of budget, or none to leave the seat idle; at most four steps, no cycle.

motivated.description: The motivated model, which the host runs in process.

parameters.description: The motivated model's parameters; a key it does not take, or a value outside its bound, is refused. An empty mapping when it takes none.

base.description: The base weight of each option, per mille.

commute.description: When to set out for a punctual part of the day: the same block as `rule`'s (`ARC-282`).

curve.description: Per-world overrides of single curves, by name, as the points written.

curves.description: The named curve set. Only `atus-a3-2025` ships (SD-DLb-8).

reply_floor.description: Per mille, 0 … 1 000: the least chance an addressed person replies.

social_need_hours.description: Hours without contact at which loneliness reaches its top, 1 … 72.

top_band.description: Out of 1 000 (per mille), 0 … 500: the band a draw chooses from.

rule.description: The rule model, which the host runs in process.

parameters.description: The rule model's parameters; a key it does not take, or a value outside its bound, is refused. An empty mapping when it takes none.

boss.description: When a manager penalizes lateness, and how hard (`ARC-287`).

commute.description: When to set out for a punctual part of the day.

needs.description: When to eat, go to bed and wake for work, in a world with `needs` and `sleep` (`ARC-286`).
